objectives.text: Speak with Torvald at his forge in Ravensford
Take the helm Hakon the Red wears
Bring the helm back to Torvald

stages.journal: Maren Holt, the elder of Ravensford, told me Hakon the Red's bandits stripped Torvald's forge of every bar of iron. She sent me to the smith.
Torvald forged the helm Hakon the Red now wears like a crown. If I bring it back, the smith will know the raids are over. Hakon holds the Old Watchtower on Greyfang Rise, south-east of the village.
I struck down Hakon the Red. Now to take Torvald's helm from his body before anyone else does.
I have Torvald's helm. Time to bring it home to the forge in Ravensford.
Torvald took his helm back and gave me the iron cuirass he had hidden under the forge floor. Ravensford owes me one.

lines.say: Torvald sings at his anvil again. Ravensford won't forget what you did.
Torvald's forge is cold for good now. Without our smith, Hakon has taken more than iron from us.
Is that Torvald's helm? Take it to him before he wears a hole in the floor.
Greyfang Rise is south-east, past the fields. Hakon keeps to the watchtower at the top.
Torvald's forge is on the east side of the village, toward the ford. He'll tell you what Hakon took.
Hakon the Red's raiders stripped our smith's forge bare. If you'd help us, start with Torvald.
Wear that cuirass well. It's the last good iron in the vale.
That's my mark on the brow! Give it here. Take this cuirass. I kept it hidden from those thieves.
You had my helm, and now you don't? Find it before some crow does.
Hakon's down? Then bring me my helm. It'll be on his body still, if the crows haven't got it.
Greyfang Rise, past the south-east fields. Hakon stands at the watchtower door, wearing my helm.
Maren sent you? Good. Hakon's lot took my iron, and Hakon took my best helm too.
Hakon's lot took my iron, and Hakon himself wears the best helm I ever made. Bring it back to me?
So you're the one who brought down Hakon. The gate is always open to you.
Word is Hakon fell on the Rise. Good riddance. The south-east road is quieter for it.
A smith dead in his own forge. Keep your blade sheathed in my village.
Going after Hakon? Take the south-east road and keep off the tower stairs until his raiders are down.
